title: 示波器专项：双通道示波器测量练习
goal: 掌握数字示波器的基本操作——通道开关、时基（秒/格）、垂直档位（伏/格）、AUTO 与 RUN/STOP，能用测量读数量出方波的峰峰值与频率
doc:
为什么要专门练示波器？

电子/嵌入式/硬件相关岗位的面试与笔试中，“会不会用示波器”是高频考点。本实验在仿真环境里复刻了真实数字示波器的核心操作（通道开关、时基、垂直档位、AUTO、RUN/STOP、测量读数），学会后迁移到真实示波器（如普源 Rigol DS1000Z、优利德 UNI-T、鼎阳 SDS 等）只需要熟悉按键位置。

电路与信号

单片机用定时器0 中断在 P1.0 输出精确 5Hz 方波（周期 200ms）→ CH1（黄）；P2.7 输出精确 2Hz 方波（周期 500ms）→ CH2（青）。真实工程产生标准测试信号就用定时器中断——软件延时循环的频率不准，这正是面试常考的细节。探头接地 GND 必须与电路共地——真实示波器不共地测出的波形是错的，这是面试常问点。

面板操作对照（仿真 ↔ 真实示波器）

本仿真台真实示波器对应作用
RUN / STOPRun/Stop 单键开始/冻结采集，冻结后可从容读数
AUTOAuto 键自动选时基与垂直档位，一键稳定显示
CH1 / CH2通道开关（1/2 键）打开/关闭对应通道显示
伏/格 − ＋垂直 SCALE 旋钮每格代表的电压（V/div），影响波形高度
秒/格 − ＋水平 SCALE 旋钮每格代表的时间（s/div），影响周期疏密
读数条 Vpp/HzMeasure 自动测量峰峰值幅度与频率直接读数

操作任务

  1. 接线：示波器的 CH1、CH2、GND 探头接口在机身下方——CH1→P2.6，CH2→P2.7，GND→正下方的接地端子（必须共地）。
  2. 编译 → 烧录运行 → 点「Autoset」，应看到黄、青两路方波稳定显示。
  3. 手动练习：旋转 HORIZONTAL 区「秒/格」旋钮（或点击旋钮左/右半）把时基调到 200ms/格，CH1 一个周期应恰好占 1 格（200ms），即 5Hz；再对照读数条验证。
  4. 把时基调到 500ms/格，验证 CH2 一个周期恰好占 1 格（500ms，即 2Hz）。
  5. 点「RUN」变「STOP」冻结波形，从读数条读出 CH1 的 Vpp 与频率。
  6. 旋转 VERTICAL 区「伏/格」旋钮把档位从 2V 调到 1V，观察波形高度翻倍（幅度不变，只是刻度变了）——这是初学者最常犯的读数错误。再用「位置」旋钮上下平移波形、拖动观察触发电平橙色虚线。

迁移到真实示波器的注意事项

  • 探头衰减档 ×1/×10：×10 档读数会自动补偿，但探头要补偿校准（方波过冲/圆角）。
  • 触发（Trigger）：真实示波器靠触发电平让波形“停稳”，本仿真台恒为 Auto 触发。
  • 带宽与采样率：测 1MHz 以上信号要关心示波器带宽，测单片机 IO（kHz 级）入门款完全够用。
  • 共地：探头地夹必须接被测电路地，测市电隔离电路时严禁地夹接火线。
checklist: 接线：CH1→P2.6、CH2→P2.7、GND→正下方接地端子（探头与电路必须共地）
编译并烧录运行，点「Autoset」得到两路稳定波形
时基调到 200ms/格：CH1 一个周期恰好占 1 格（5Hz）；500ms/格 时 CH2 占 1 格（2Hz）
分别开关 CH1/CH2 通道，体会通道显示控制
RUN/STOP 冻结波形，读出 CH1 的 Vpp 与频率（理论值 5V / 5Hz）
goalEn: Basic digital-oscilloscope operation — channel on/off, timebase (s/div), vertical scale (V/div), AUTO and RUN/STOP — and measuring the peak-to-peak voltage and frequency of square waves.
docEn:
Why practice the oscilloscope?

In interviews and written tests for electronics / embedded / hardware jobs, "can you use an oscilloscope" is a frequent question. This lab replicates the core operations of a real digital scope (channel on/off, timebase, vertical scale, AUTO, RUN/STOP, measurement readouts) in the simulator. Once learned, transferring to a real scope (Rigol DS1000Z, UNI-T, Siglent SDS, etc.) is just a matter of finding the buttons.

Circuit and signals

Using a Timer-0 interrupt the MCU outputs an exact 5Hz square wave (200ms period) on P1.0 → CH1 (yellow), and an exact 2Hz square wave (500ms period) on P2.7 → CH2 (cyan). Real engineering generates standard test signals with timer interrupts — software delay loops are not frequency-accurate; this is a favorite interview detail. The probe ground must share ground with the circuit — measurements without a common ground are wrong on a real scope, a classic interview question.

Panel mapping (simulator ↔ real scope)

This simulatorReal scopeFunction
RUN / STOPRun/Stop buttonStart / freeze acquisition; frozen waveforms can be read at leisure
AUTOAuto buttonAutomatically pick timebase and vertical scale for a stable display
CH1 / CH2Channel keys (1/2)Show / hide the corresponding channel
V/div − +Vertical SCALE knobVolts per division — affects waveform height
s/div − +Horizontal SCALE knobSeconds per division — affects period spacing
Vpp/Hz readout barMeasure (auto)Direct readout of amplitude and frequency

Operation tasks

  1. Wiring: the scope probes CH1, CH2 and GND are at the bottom of the instrument — CH1→P2.6, CH2→P2.7, GND→the ground terminal right below (common ground is mandatory).
  2. Build → flash → click "Autoset": two stable square waves (yellow and cyan) should appear.
  3. Manual practice: turn the HORIZONTAL "s/div" knob (or click its left/right half) to 200ms/div — one CH1 cycle should occupy exactly 1 division (200ms), i.e. 5Hz; verify with the readout bar.
  4. Set 500ms/div and verify one CH2 cycle occupies exactly 1 division (500ms, i.e. 2Hz).
  5. Click "RUN" so it becomes "STOP" to freeze the waveform; read CH1's Vpp and frequency from the readout bar.
  6. Turn the VERTICAL "V/div" knob from 2V to 1V and watch the waveform double in height (the amplitude is unchanged — only the scale changed; a classic beginner misread). Use the "position" knob to shift the trace vertically, and drag to inspect the orange trigger-level dashed line.

Moving to a real oscilloscope

  • Probe attenuation ×1/×10: the ×10 setting compensates readings automatically, but the probe must be compensation-calibrated (square-wave overshoot/rounding).
  • Trigger: a real scope stabilizes the trace with a trigger level; this simulator always uses Auto trigger.
  • Bandwidth & sample rate: only matters above ~1MHz; entry-level scopes are fine for kHz MCU I/O.
  • Common ground: the probe ground clip must connect to the circuit ground; never clip it to a live mains wire.
checklistEn: Wiring: CH1→P2.6, CH2→P2.7, GND→the ground terminal right below (probe and circuit must share ground)
Build, flash and run; click "Autoset" to get two stable traces
At 200ms/div one CH1 cycle occupies exactly 1 division (5Hz); at 500ms/div CH2 occupies 1 division (2Hz)
Toggle CH1/CH2 on and off to practice channel display control
Freeze with RUN/STOP and read CH1's Vpp and frequency (theoretical 5V / 5Hz)
